data.summary: The reviews show strong signs of being inauthentic. All sampled reviews are 5-star with similar promotional language, specific employee names are repeatedly mentioned in positive contexts, and there's complete absence from other review platforms despite having 81 Google reviews. The reviews read like marketing copy rather than genuine customer experiences.
fake_signals: All 8 sampled reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
Reviews follow similar narrative structure (storm damage -> inspection -> smooth process)
Multiple reviews mention specific employee names (Devin, Maxwell, Howard, Brent, Ryan) in promotional context
Lack of specific negative details or constructive criticism
No presence on other major review platforms despite high Google volume
Reviews sound like marketing testimonials rather than authentic customer experiences
authentic_signals: Some specific project details mentioned (metal roof, skylight, whole house fan)
Mention of Texas weather conditions adds some authenticity
data.discrepancy_explanation: Only Google reviews exist (4.9★ with 81 reviews). No presence on BBB, Yelp, Angi, Houzz, or Glassdoor. This is highly unusual for a legitimate contractor with 81 Google reviews.

reviews.text: Our experience with this roofing company was truly fantastic. Our project manager, Devin, made everything run smoothly from start to finish. We originally planned to just get our roof replaced, but after seeing the affordable quotes, we ended up having them handle the roof, soffit, fascia, and gutters, and even asked them to come back to install a new front door. Devin never pushed extra services on us—the prices were just that good, making it possible for us to do more than we expected. Communication was clear and timely throughout the process. The roofing crew showed up on schedule, worked efficiently, and delivered excellent results. Our home looks better than ever. Compared to the six other companies we got quotes from, their prices were much lower—some by several thousand dollars. The quality of the workmanship really impressed us. We already have a couple more home projects in mind, and we’ll definitely be calling this team again. I highly recommend this roofing company to anyone looking for fair prices and great service. They truly take care of their customers.
reviews.author: G Mason

reviews.text: The team did an excellent job with my roof replacement. The sales reps were very thorough—they pointed out all the issues with my roof, took detailed photos, and even went into the attic to make sure nothing was missed. They explained the whole process clearly and helped me understand what would happen next. On installation day, the crew arrived early and worked hard to remove the old shingles in the Texas heat. Maxwell, who seemed to be leading the crew, was very helpful and made sure everything stayed on schedule. They handled everything just as promised, including removing an old roof exhaust fan and properly boarding up the area, which was part of my original agreement. After the new shingles were installed, the crew cleaned up the area well, making sure there were no leftover materials or nails in the driveway. The roof looks fantastic and is built to withstand the Texas sun and storms. I checked the attic myself and was pleased to see everything in good order. Communication throughout the process was clear, and the team made sure I was satisfied before finishing up. Overall, I’m very happy with the quality of the workmanship and the professionalism of the team. I highly recommend this roofer for anyone needing roofing services in Texas.
reviews.author: michael hart

reviews.text: After getting several quotes following a big storm, I chose this roofing company. Howard was detailed and upfront with the estimate, which I appreciated. The crew worked on my roof during the hot summer and made sure everything was done professionally and kept the area very tidy. Not long after, another storm came through, but my new roof held up perfectly—no shingles lost and everything looked great. Howard even followed up afterward to make sure my roof was still in good shape. If you need any roofing work done, I definitely recommend giving them a call.
reviews.author: leroy porter

reviews.text: After a big hail storm, Brent came by and offered a free roof inspection. We decided to let him take a look, and he pointed out the hail damage on our roof. Brent helped us through the whole insurance process and was even there when the adjuster came by, making everything much easier for us. Our insurance covered a new roof and gutters, and the whole project was finished quickly and without any issues. The crew did a great job cleaning up after themselves, and we’re very happy with how everything turned out. I definitely recommend this roofing company to anyone needing help after a storm. Brent was professional, helpful, and made the whole process stress-free.
reviews.author: H Simon

reviews.text: I got several estimates for a new metal roof. Ryan came out and was very professional and knowledgeable. He patiently answered all my questions and clearly explained the whole installation process. I’m really happy we chose this company for our roof. They ordered the materials quickly and the crew arrived right on schedule. Everyone was polite, paid close attention to detail, and showed real skill in their work. I highly recommend this roofing team to anyone looking for quality roofers in Texas.
reviews.author: jesse villa

reviews.text: Working with Hayes & Sons LLC on my roofing project was an excellent experience from the very start. Devin was extremely thorough when evaluating my roof, taking the time to explain all the important details—like the materials they’d use, the timeline, and what I could expect throughout the process. Devin always did exactly what was promised: he arrived on time for our first meeting, delivered the estimate promptly, got the necessary permits fast, and made sure the materials were delivered before the project began. Communication was clear and quick—Devin responded right away to my emails and texts, and the whole contracting and payment process was handled electronically, which made everything really convenient. On installation day, I received photos showing what was discovered after removing the old shingles, so I was fully informed about the repairs needed before the new roof was put on. The repairs matched Devin’s original assessment and estimate, so there were no surprises. The work started and finished as scheduled and stayed within budget. Based on this great experience, I’ll definitely call them again for any future roofing needs!
reviews.author: Corey Brewer

reviews.text: Devin and his crew are truly skilled, professional, and fair with their prices. I’ve used their roofing services in Grand Prairie for a few repairs after some heavy Texas winds, and always had great results. When it was finally time to replace the whole roof, I knew right away who to trust because of their outstanding work before. The new roof looks fantastic, and the quality of the materials is much better than what we had before. The team was friendly, worked quickly, and had everything finished the same day. Devin even took the extra step to carefully check the driveway for stray nails after the clean-up. If you’re looking for a knowledgeable, reliable, and efficient roofer in the area, you won’t find anyone better.
reviews.author: Colin Morton

reviews.text: After a hailstorm damaged my roof, I needed to find a reliable roofing company. Being new to the area, I wasn’t sure who to trust since there were so many options. Maxwell had previously come by to check on my roof after a strong windstorm, so I was already familiar with him and his work. When he came back this time, we talked about what repairs were needed, and I decided to hire his team. Since I was getting a new roof, I also wanted to add a skylight and a whole house fan. I am very happy with the quality of all the work they did. Maxwell was always available to answer my calls and questions. He explained the whole process with the insurance company and made everything easy to understand. He and his crew even went above and beyond by helping with a few extra things. I would definitely hire them again for any roofing needs.
reviews.author: Gladys Decker
